<div class="review-text">
Plain and simple surreal turn-based RPG. Exactly what it says on the tin; if you enjoyed other entries in the genre (notable examples being Undertale and Earthbound, the titles from which avoiding comparison is impossible), this game will also probably suit your fancy. I personally detest the tedious, grindy, and slow gameplay, but I was nevertheless quite interested by the story, which I believe is the main appeal of these sorts of games anyway.
</div>
